"""Bounded diagnostic of MMG's first-pass distance parameter, not FEA admission."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "bin"))
from pueue_progress import report

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--hausd", type=float, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=180)
args = parser.parse_args()
output = args.output.resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
shutil.copy2(__file__, output / "probe.py")
state = {"fraction": 0, "message": "Loading bounded MMG distance probe"}
start = time.monotonic()
stop = threading.Event()


def heartbeat():
    while not stop.is_set():
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
        report(state["fraction"], state["message"], eta_s=max(0, args.timeout - elapsed), hausd=args.hausd, elapsed_s=round(elapsed, 1))
        stop.wait(2)


thread = threading.Thread(target=heartbeat, daemon=True)
thread.start()
try:
    import pyvista as pv
    from microgen_benchmark.backends import configure_mmg_cli
    from microgen_benchmark.cases import CASES
    from microgen_benchmark.geometry import geometry_metrics

    case = next(c for c in CASES if c.id == "gyroid")
    seed = Path("benchmarks/microgen/output/mmg-first-pass-probe/input-required.mesh").resolve()
    cli = configure_mmg_cli()
    command = [cli["mmg_cli_executable"], "-in", str(seed), "-out", str(output / "first-distance.mesh"), "-nofem", "-hausd", str(args.hausd)]
    doc = {"scope": "First-pass sampled boundary diagnostic only; no volume validity or FEA certificate.", "case": case.record(), "cells": 32, "cli": cli, "command": command, "timeout_s": args.timeout, "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(seed.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    state.update(fraction=1 / 3, message="MMG first pass with distance control only")
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    with (output / "mmg.log").open("w") as log:
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=args.timeout, check=False)
            doc.update(status="ok" if completed.returncode == 0 else "failed", returncode=completed.returncode, command_s=time.perf_counter() - begin)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            doc.update(status="timeout", command_s=None, censored_runtime_s=args.timeout)
    mesh = output / "first-distance.mesh"
    if doc["status"] == "ok" and mesh.exists():
        state.update(fraction=2 / 3, message="Sampling completed first-pass boundary")
        grid = pv.read(mesh)
        poly = grid.extract_surface(algorithm="dataset_surface").triangulate()
        doc.update(nodes=grid.n_points, cells=grid.n_cells, mesh_sha256=hashlib.sha256(mesh.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), **geometry_metrics(poly.points, poly.faces.reshape(-1, 4)[:, 1:], case))
    doc["probe_source"] = Path(__file__).read_text()
    (output / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k not in {"probe_source", "case", "command"}}), flush=True)
    state.update(fraction=1, message="Bounded first-pass diagnostic complete")
    report(1, state["message"], eta_s=0)
finally:
    stop.set()
    thread.join()
